blockReasons.notBankConnected: Only bank-connected transactions can be reconciled.
blockReasons.linkedTransfer: Linked transfers can't be reconciled. Unlink the transfer first.
blockReasons.refundLinked: Refund-linked transactions can't be reconciled. Unlink the refund first.
blockReasons.tooFew: Select at least 2 transactions to merge.
blockReasons.tooMany: Too many transactions selected (merge: up to {mergeMax}, remove: up to {removeMax}).
blockReasons.differentAccounts: All transactions must belong to the same account.

merge.title: Merge transactions
merge.description: Pick the transaction to keep. The others are removed and can be restored from History.
merge.confirm: Merge and remove {count} | Merge and remove {count}

remove.title: Remove {count} transaction? | Remove {count} transactions?
remove.description: Removed transactions stop counting toward balances and stats. Budget, group and subscription links are detached. You can restore them from History, but the links won't come back.

restoreDialog.title: Restore {count} transaction? | Restore {count} transactions?
restoreDialog.description: Restored transactions count toward balances and stats again. If they were merged, the kept transaction stays, so you may see duplicates again. Budget, group and subscription links detached on removal don't come back.

notifications.merged: Merged, removed {count} duplicate | Merged, removed {count} duplicates
